neighbours.label: an upcoming event drawing near in time (as the date gets closer, the final weeks before, counting down)
fire: I will post more details about the trip as the date gets closer.
Ticket prices usually rise in the final weeks before the concert.
We are counting down the days until the wedding in June.
As the election approaches, the candidates are spending more on ads.
More vendors will be announced as the festival draws near.
With only three days left before the launch, the team is working late.
As her due date approaches, the doctor will see her every week.
The shop gets busier and busier as Christmas gets closer.
quiet: I posted more details about the trip after we came home.
Ticket prices usually drop in the weeks after the concert.
We are still talking about the wedding we went to in June.
After the election, the candidates stopped spending money on ads.
More vendors were thanked once the festival had ended.
Three days after the launch, the team finally went home early.
After her baby was born, the doctor saw her once a month.
The shop got quieter and quieter in the weeks after Christmas.
